answer: For a poll on sable habitat by the inlet and knoll, officials check property boundaries and poll-bound owner signatures against the land registry, rejecting mismatches. The server selects a largest set of valid properties whose boundaries are at least 1 km apart, breaking ties by registry ID order, and counts one vote per selected property. Extra votes require access to suitably spaced properties, potentially costing negotiation. One owner can control many properties, and nearby owners can be excluded.
